showcasePaginationHint: 57 items, 15 per page — scroll down to load more, pull down to refresh

showcaseCrudRolledBack: Not saved — the list was put back

showcaseFailuresEmailInvalid: The email address is not valid

showcaseApiStepGuard: Rejects the request before it leaves when the device has no network
showcaseApiStepAuth: Adds the access token and the app language
showcaseApiStepBody: Unwraps the envelope into the model
showcaseApiStepMapper: Turns the exception into a Failure — raw data, no translation
showcaseApiStepRepository: The one boundary: returns an Either, no try/catch in any repository
showcaseApiStepUiMapper: The one place a failure becomes what the screen does
showcaseApiServer403: Answers 403 — this action is not permitted
showcaseApiServer404: Answers 404 — no record with that id
showcaseApiServer500: Answers 500 — a defect inside the server
showcaseApiServerTimeout: No answer within the time limit
showcaseApiBackRetry500: A 500 is a defect, not a hiccup: not retried
showcaseApiBackRetryOffline: Blocked on the device itself: not retried
showcaseApiGuardBlocked: No network: the request never leaves the device
showcaseApiCubit: Emits the success state and the list draws
showcaseApiFieldError: Name must be at least 3 characters
showcaseApiUiLogin: The session ends and the app goes to sign-in
showcaseApiUiError: The screen shows the message in place

showcaseBackGuardDiscardMessage: What you typed is not saved yet.

showcaseTypographyParagraph: Every line of text in the app takes its size and weight from the theme, so a change in one place reaches every screen at once.
showcaseScreenBoxHint: At phone width neither width is bounded — only the side padding applies. Move the simulated width to see where the limits begin.
showcaseMotionReduceHint: With reduce motion on, every duration becomes zero and the motion stands still.
showcaseDisplayNoClipboard: Copying needs ClipboardService, which is not registered here

showcaseGesturesHintLongPress: Long-press a row, then drag it
showcaseGesturesSwipeHint: Swipe a row sideways from a side that has an action
showcaseBottomBarApplyHint: Apply to the app's own bar, then switch tabs
showcaseInputsObscureOneLine: An obscured field is always one line — maxLines is ignored with it.
showcaseInputsShook: The field is invalid — it shook to draw the eye.
showcaseInputsFootnote: You can change the choice later.
showcaseCubitsLogEmpty: Press a button — every emitted state lands here with its time
showcaseCubitsSafeIntro: An answer that lands after the screen has closed. With SafeCubit it is dropped quietly; with a plain Cubit, emit throws — a real crash in release builds.
showcaseCubitsLeaveHint: Try it: Slow, then Leave the screen before the answer lands — once with each base.
showcaseCubitsDropped: dropped by SafeCubit — nothing is listening anyway
showcaseCubitsCrash: caught here for the demo; in an app nothing catches it
showcaseCubitsMutationIntro: A write returns what to tell the reader — it never emits it as state. Press save with failed twice: the message is said twice, and the state only ever holds "saving".
showcaseCubitsAskAnyway: The server asks: go ahead anyway?
showcaseCubitsRefreshIntro: Each refresh() emits a new RefreshState that never equals the last, so every listener rebuilds.
showcaseCubitsPagingIntro: The real PaginationCubit, fed from the device. Watch which calls emit a state — and which emit nothing, like nextPage() after the last page.
showcaseMediaTapped: Photo tapped — instead of opening the preview
showcaseNavigationStepRange: currentStep must be between 1 and totalSteps — the widget asserts it
showcaseStorageAdapterNote: A real StorageService adapter from the template, running in memory — the app's own store is never touched.
showcaseStorageSettingsIntro: A settings screen that keeps its choices: every change writes through StorageService, and Restart starts from the defaults, then reads them back.
showcaseStorageCacheIntro: Clear only what you own: the request cache removes its prefixed keys with keys() and delete. clear() takes the settings with it — try it after setting some above.
showcaseStorageContentsAbove: The effect shows in the store table above.
showcaseStorageFlagsIntro: Build-time switches — constants, never stored, never changed at runtime.
showcaseApiKnobCache: This request opts into the cache — by default nothing is cached
showcaseApiKnobCacheEntry: What the cache holds for this request
showcaseApiKnobRefresh: A token refresh layer is registered — the template registers one
showcaseApiCacheOff: Not opted in — goes to the network
showcaseApiCacheHit: A fresh answer on the device: returned at once with x-from-cache; the guard and the server are never asked — even offline
showcaseApiCacheStale: Past its TTL (5 minutes by default) — goes to the network
showcaseApiCacheMiss: Nothing cached — goes to the network
showcaseApiCacheWrite: Opted in and 200: stored until its TTL runs out
showcaseApiAuthExpire: No refresh layer: clears the session and fires AuthEvent.sessionExpired
showcaseApiAuthForbidden: Never signs out. When the body says message_key = permission_missing it fires AuthEvent.permissionsStale and permissions are re-read
showcaseApiRefreshOk: The token is refreshed once, silently, and the original request is replayed through the whole chain. Concurrent requests wait on the same refresh
showcaseApiRefreshRefused: A real refusal: onRefreshFailed() clears the session, then AuthEvent.sessionExpired
showcaseApiRefreshDeferred: The refresh never reached a server: the session is kept and AuthEvent.sessionRefreshDeferred fires — nobody is signed out over a dropped packet
showcaseApiRetryAfterLong: The server asked for more than 10 seconds: the request is not held — the failure surfaces now and the user decides
showcaseApiRetryUsedUp: Retries used up ({}) — the failure goes on
showcaseApiRetryWait: Waits {} s (1, then 2, then 4), then replays the request through the chain
showcaseApiRetryWaitServer: Waits {} s as the server's Retry-After asked — its number beats the back-off curve
showcaseApiUiFromCache: The screen draws from the device — no request, no wait
showcaseApiUiDeferred: The session is kept; the request fails as a network error (NoInternetFailure) — the next attempt retries
showcaseApiRetryRulesNote: A rule in the code, not an option: a 500 is a defect that repeats, and retrying it multiplies the load on a failing server. A request the network guard blocked never left the device.
showcaseApiOriginIntro: The first question at startup, before any token is read: did the data on this device come from the current server?
showcaseApiOriginStart: Before the first frame, before the session is restored
showcaseApiOriginEmpty: A missing setting, not a new server: everything is kept and a warning logged — no wipe because an env file was not passed
showcaseApiOriginSame: Same origin: one key read, nothing wiped
showcaseApiOriginChanged: A different server: what is on this device belongs to it
showcaseApiOriginSession: Token and refresh token — the old server's token is useless here
showcaseApiOriginAccount: Every account key and module row — device preferences stay
showcaseApiOriginRemembered: Saved accounts were addresses on the old server
showcaseApiOriginWiped: The device was wiped — no session is left, so startup goes on signed out
